info.title: apicourier
info.description: Run API requests, collections, flows and SQL queries from the terminal or CI, using the same execution pipeline as the ApiCourier desktop app. Git-native and local-first — your workspace is plain YAML in your repository, with no export step and no account required.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ApiCourier CLI. Run requests, collections, and flows from the terminal or CI.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Path to the ApiCourier workspace (overrides APICOURIER_WORKSPACE env var and auto-detection).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Emit diagnostic logging to stderr. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress non-error output. [default: False]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI color output (also respects NO_COLOR env var). [default: False]

options.name: --trust-scripts
options.description: Allow this workspace's C# scripts to run. Off by default (fail-closed): C# scripts from an untrusted workspace are skipped, since they are not fully sandboxed on Windows. Only pass this for a workspace whose scripts you trust (also settable via APICOURIER_TRUST_SCRIPTS=1). [default: False]

options.description: Result output format: json|csv|table|insert. Default: table on TTY, json when redirected.
